classification.difficultyReason: Construct and measure an adjacent pair, then verify the straight-angle sum.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Draw a horizontal line, $AOB$. Allow at least $10\text{ cm}$ of space around your line.

answer.short: A horizontal line with $O$ between $A$ and $B$.
answer.worked: Draw a horizontal straight line and label points $A$, $O$ and $B$ in that order. Leave at least $10\text{ cm}$ of space around the line for the construction.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Draw another ray, $OP$, going diagonally upwards from $O$.

answer.short: A ray from $O$ diagonally upwards, labelled $OP$.
answer.worked: On the construction in part a, draw a ray from $O$ diagonally upwards and mark a point $P$ on it. For example, draw $OP$ upwards to the right at $60^{\circ}$ to $OB$.

spec.description: Authored sample of the requested student construction; the source supplies no fixed diagram or angle measurements.
spec.mathematics: A, O and B are collinear with O between A and B. OP points diagonally upwards to the right. The sample adjacent angles are 120 degrees and 60 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Solution only; sample measurements are never supplied in the student prompt.

answer.short: Answers vary. Sample: $\angle AOP=120^{\circ}$ and $\angle BOP=60^{\circ}$.
answer.worked: Place the protractor centre at $O$ and align its baseline with $AB$. Read each angle from the scale starting at its corresponding horizontal arm. For the sample construction, $\angle AOP=120^{\circ}$ and $\angle BOP=60^{\circ}$.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Check that they obey the statement, ‘Angles in a straight angle add to $180^{\circ}$’.

answer.worked:
Add the two measured angles. For the sample construction:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOP+\angle BOP&=120^{\circ}+60^{\circ}\\\angle AOP+\angle BOP&=180^{\circ}.
\end{align*}$$
The adjacent angles form the straight angle $AOB$, confirming the statement. Small discrepancies in measured totals can result from drawing or measurement error.
